definition: Learn to identify the actual authoritative current traffic code/rule and its user/category/place/date/condition scope, distinguish legal rule, advice and provider instruction and explain what complete vehicle-circulation knowledge the case requires. Retain unknown applicability or contradictions for the competent owner; knowing a rule does not establish ability or permission to drive.
source: Capability Atlas individually authored profession pathways v1

assessment.method: Observe the authored task and changed case; record support, actual result, errors and feedback.
criteria: Defines complete current selected national-code/rules-of-road knowledge scope
Matches actual dated jurisdiction/user/vehicle/place/condition and source authority
Retains unknowns and knowledge-versus-operation/legal-authority distinctions

evidence_basis: Individually authored Atlas proposal. Source facets are mapped in the profession route; no external practitioner review, learner observation or occupational certification is claimed.
input_specification: A qualified road-safety/legal instructor supplies current authoritative Irish traffic-code/rule excerpts and complete independent meaning/applicability expectations for the actual dated jurisdiction, user/vehicle category and place. The current RSA publication/update source is checked at use; old copies or another country are not assumed current. Accessible reading/communication support is allowed. These are knowledge cases, not vehicle operation, a driving entitlement or authority to manage public traffic. A complete model knowledge inventory covers road/lane position, junction priority, traffic controls/signs/markings, current speed requirements, stopping/parking, duties toward vulnerable users and conditional/special-category restrictions or directions. Full independent rule/case/source mappings are supplied. No fixed national speed, vehicle licence class or universal crossing instruction is invented.
output_specification: Defines complete current selected national-code/rules-of-road knowledge scope; Matches actual dated jurisdiction/user/vehicle/place/condition and source authority; Retains unknowns and knowledge-versus-operation/legal-authority distinctions

label: Assess and reduce actual environmental risks/practices across the selected footwear route
definition: Assess actual environmental flows/risks under the declared boundary, perform/check the separately taught permitted reduced-harm practices in different actual stages, preserve mandatory controls and verify actual scoped results. understanding_check.what_changes: The same footwear model uses a new material/product and an outside finishing provider.
understanding_check.materials: Explicit actual revised material/process/supplier pack and previous internal-route results.
understanding_check.prompt: Identify required new actual compatibility, method, flow and result checks.
expected_evidence: The changed actual material/provider scope is rechecked.
Old site savings do not clear new outsourced impacts or untaught methods.
Missing controls/evidence remain unresolved.
understanding_check.evidence_scope: An individually authored unreviewed proposal for actual bounded footwear-manufacturing environmental assessment and taught practice changes. It is not a certified lifecycle footprint, universal waste classification, regulatory determination or proof of general environmental minimisation.

difficulties.misconception: Counting a stage map or waste-sorting model as actual complete environmental improvement.
difficulties.feedback: Retain actual assessed flows/controls, separately taught practices and comparable scoped results.

effort.spacing: Use separate revisits with changed examples and responsive breaks; no fixed age or calendar timetable is assumed.
effort.basis: Atlas author judgement for planning; no learner timing observations or instructional validation.
assumptions: Access, materials and the stated support are available.
Active time excludes setup, waiting, breaks and learning unrelated prerequisites.
The planning range is provisional; repeated occupational practice can take longer and is not inferred from successful card tasks.
